'''''Merchant One''''' was a [[C-ROC Gozanti-class light cruiser|C-ROC ''Gozanti''-class light cruiser]] owned by the [[crime lord]] [[Azmorigan]]. The ship carried a number of armaments, including laser turrets and [[laser cannon]]s used in criminal operations.<ref name="Databank" /> The vessel also held a number of [[escape pod]]s.<ref name="Idiot's Array" />
